instruction: A clean, realistic documentary photograph in a medium full shot shows a bright indoor ballet studio with white wooden platforms. On the right, the woman in a black long-sleeved top and white tights (R1) sits stretching her right leg forward, holding her foot with both hands. Beside her on the left, the young girl in a black crop top and shorts (R2) mirrors the pose, stretching her left leg forward and holding her foot. Both look forward with focused expressions under soft, natural side lighting that fills the clean white space.
elements: R1 stretches her right leg forward while R2 mirrors by stretching her left leg forward
R1 holds her own right foot with both hands while R2 holds her own left foot with both hands
R1 and R2 are seated side by side in mirrored ballet stretching poses
R1 and R2 each hold their own forward foot during the stretch
white wooden platforms in the ballet studio
